summary: Reusable bounded idea-sharpening component plus /z-sharpen wrapper. The component assesses clarity and alternatives, returns proceed/sharpen_more/route_to_brainstorm plus GRILL.md content when ready; the wrapper owns slug, collision, telemetry, final write, and advisory handoff. /z-plan now invokes the component as a mandatory pre-Premise-check step (0-sharpen).

entry_points.summary: Separates reusable inline component from /z-sharpen command wrapper.
Component does not own slug, collision, telemetry, or wrapper lifecycle.
Caller-owned prompt/precontext/destination inputs; no interview subagent.
Clarity, alternatives, recommendation, and GRILL.md output contract.
User-facing lifecycle, empty-topic bootstrap, slug/collision, telemetry, final writes.
Precontext-only dirs continue; finished-plan dirs require confirmation.
Writes only on convergence and never writes BRAINSTORM.md.

invariants: Reusable component is inline orchestration guidance, not a subagent and not the /z-sharpen wrapper.
Callers own interaction policy, destination context, and whether/where GRILL.md is written.
Component output is exactly one of proceed, sharpen_more, route_to_brainstorm.
User-facing wrapper owns empty-topic bootstrap, slug resolution, collision prompts, telemetry, final writes, and advisory handoff.
Bounded adaptive escalation: ask the highest-signal clarification only; do not run a checklist.
Never exhaustively interrogate every dimension — that is /z-grill's job.
Advisory handoff only — never auto-dispatches to /z-plan or /z-brainstorm.
No active-plan registration — /z-sharpen is not a plan-family command.
/z-plan's 0-sharpen step is mandatory and conversational (not opt-out) as of the intent-compiler redesign; it runs before the Premise check and before Phase 0.5's separate brainstorm-ask gate.
gotchas: Do not invoke the /z-sharpen wrapper from /z-brainstorm; use the reusable component contract only.
A proceed recommendation means /z-plan is likely next, but the caller/user must choose; no automatic launch.
route_to_brainstorm means parallel framing is useful, not that the component should write BRAINSTORM.md.
Precontext-only collision is silent overwrite (no prompt); finished-plan collision requires AskUserQuestion.
GRILL.md schema is shared with /z-grill — last-writer-wins if both run on the same slug.
No active-plan registration — /z-sharpen is not a plan-family command.

/z-plan dropped its old opt-out auto-sharpen path (--no-sharpen flag, workflow.auto_sharpen config, handoff-input heuristics) in favor of a mandatory 0-sharpen step; the sharpen_gate event schema changed to decision (existing_grill|sharpened) plus a new recommendation field (proceed|ask_brainstorm).
